name: Titan Company Ltd
about: Titan Company Ltd is among India’s most respected lifestyle companies. It has established leadership positions in the Watches, Jewellery and Eyewear categories led by its trusted brands and differentiated customer experience. It was founded in 1984 as a joint-venture between TATA Group and Tamilnadu Industrial Development Corporation (TIDCO). [1]

flags.text: Only 43% of the last five years' profit arrived as operating cash

business.what: Titan sells jewellery (Tanishq, Mia, Zoya, CaratLane), watches and eyecare products, plus international jewellery through Damas. It earns revenue mainly from product sales, with jewellery through its stores as the core.

segments.name: Jewellery (Tanishq, Mia, Zoya)
segments.comment: Strong all-round growth; studded demand recovered after a May lull; normalised EBIT margin 10.9%.

segments.name: CaratLane
segments.comment: Grew across the business; received a ₹21 crore customs-duty gain this quarter.

segments.name: Watches
segments.comment: Revenue growth outpaced EBIT; normalised EBIT margin 17.8% versus 18.6% last year.

segments.name: Eyecare
segments.comment: Named as a division on the call; no quarterly performance commentary was given.

segments.name: International (Damas and other subsidiaries)
segments.comment: Damas made a loss on Gulf footfall and ticket-size falls; rest of portfolio earns 5-6% EBIT.

kpis.name: Jewellery (TMZ) normalised EBIT margin, incl. customs and MTM gains
kpis.value: 10.9% (vs 11.3% last year, which also had a 50 bps one-off)

kpis.name: Customs duty gain realised in Q1 (consolidated)
Jewellery EBIT uplift from accounting MTM on inventory

ledger.promise: Jewellery revenue growth for YTD December FY26 to be better than first-half growth
ledger.quote: by the time we end -- we come to YTD December, our growth rates should have become better than the first half growth rates.
ledger.actual: Consolidated revenue: H1 FY26 35,248 vs 27,800 (+26.8%); 9M FY26 60,664 vs 45,540 (+33.2%). Jewellery segment figures not provided.

ledger.promise: Open about 40 new Tanishq stores in FY26 (35-40 range)
ledger.quote: purely from new stores on Tanishq, I think 35 to 40 is a reasonable range to expect. 40 is the target.
ledger.actual: No store count in the materials and no later call reports FY26 openings.

ledger.promise: FY26 jewellery EBIT growth slightly slower than revenue growth
ledger.quote: So I would expect EBIT growth, absolute amount growth might be slightly slower than the revenue growth for the full year.
ledger.actual: No segment EBIT. Consolidated FY26 EBITDA 8,357 (+46.8%) grew faster than revenue 87,584 (+44.9%), which includes Damas from Q4.

ledger.promise: Jewellery margin to come down slightly in Q3 FY26
ledger.quote: I do expect in quarter 3 to slightly come down.
ledger.actual: No segment margin. Consolidated EBITDA margin rose from 10.0% in Q2 FY26 to 10.7% in Q3 FY26.

ledger.promise: Consistent, stable margin range with only small variations
ledger.quote: we are trying to deliver consistent, stable range, but it could be slightly pluses and minuses, not significant variations we are expecting.
ledger.actual: Consolidated EBITDA margin went 10.7% (Q3 FY26), 7.2% (Q4 FY26), 13.5% (Q1 FY27), 14.5% (Q2 FY27): a range of 730 bps.

ledger.promise: Watches margin at 15-16% over 1-2 years, gradually moving to 16-17%
ledger.quote: mid -teen is a good number to aim for, 15% to 16% for the business, at least in the 1-year, 2-year time frame.
ledger.actual: No watches segment data in the materials and no later call reports it.

ledger.quote: consolidation of Damas books into Titan consolidation will start from 1st January
ledger.actual: Q4 FY26 revenue 26,920 vs 14,916 in Q4 FY25 (+80.5%). Q1 FY27 call discusses Damas inside the international portfolio.

ledger.promise: 15-20% revenue CAGR over three to five years
ledger.quote: we believe 15% to 20%, three to five-year kind of horizon is certainly to be delivered on a CAGR basis
ledger.actual: Too early. H1 FY27 revenue 41,970 vs 35,248 (+19.1%), with Damas included; Q2 FY27 grew only 10.1% YoY.

ledger.promise: Keep FY27 jewellery sales growth at the guidance given earlier
ledger.quote: we are hopeful to keep to the same guidance we may have given in the past.
ledger.actual: Target not stated. Consolidated growth was +29.3% in Q1 FY27 and +10.1% in Q2 FY27. Q1 FY27 call only says 'double-digit'.

ledger.quote: we are very, very hopeful we will be able to deliver on a full year basis
ledger.actual: Full year not over. Q1 FY27 normalised jewellery margin was 10.9%, per the call. No segment data for Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: Q1 FY27 customs-duty and MTM gains to reverse through the P&L over the next 2-3 quarters
ledger.quote: Over next 2 to 3 quarters, these gains would gradually flow through P&L.
ledger.actual: No reversal seen yet. Q2 FY27 consolidated EBITDA margin rose to 14.5% from 13.5%; PBT 3,000 was above EBITDA 2,983.

ledger.promise: International portfolio to make positive EBIT in FY27; ex-Damas at 5-6% EBIT margin
ledger.quote: I would expect overall portfolio would still turn out to be positive EBIT performance for the full year.
ledger.actual: FY27 not over, and the materials give no international segment data.

current_guidance.target: About 11% for FY27, with 11% as the 'centre of gravity' (plus or minus)
current_guidance.quote: more of 11% being the center of gravity for jewellery business margin, we would be around that plus/minus something can happen

current_guidance.target: 'Healthy'/'aggressive' double-digit growth, enough to reach the FY30 goals
current_guidance.quote: we are committed to a double -digit healthy growth in value in the jewellery business. So that's the only way we'll get to our committed FY 30 goals

current_guidance.target: Q1 FY27 gains reverse gradually through the P&L
current_guidance.quote: Over next 2 to 3 quarters, these gains would gradually flow through P&L.

current_guidance.target: Positive EBIT for the whole portfolio in FY27; ex-Damas at 5-6% EBIT margin
current_guidance.quote: I would expect overall portfolio would still turn out to be positive EBIT performance for the full year.
So their normal trajectory should be towards 10%.

credibility.label: mixed
credibility.summary: The checkable revenue promises held: growth picked up from H1 to 9M FY26 and Damas was consolidated on schedule. The promise of a stable margin range did not hold: consolidated EBITDA margin moved between 7.2% and 14.5% within three quarters. Most operating targets (store openings, watches, eyewear, CaratLane, Q3 jewellery margin) cannot be checked with these materials, and growth language softened from '15-20% CAGR' in Q4 FY26 to 'double-digit' in Q1 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management said margins would stay in a consistent, stable range, with no large variations.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated EBITDA margin: 10.0% (Q2 FY26), 10.7% (Q3), 7.2% (Q4), 13.5% (Q1 FY27), 14.5% (Q2 FY27).

narrative_vs_numbers.story: In Q4 FY26, management said the gold-price hit to margin was visible but small (10-20 bps lost).
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q4 FY26 consolidated EBITDA margin was 7.2%, against 10.3% in Q4 FY25 (-310 bps). This also includes Damas from Q4, so it is not a like-for-like comparison.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management said the elevated Q1 FY27 margin came from customs-duty and MTM gains that would reverse over the coming quarters.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Q2 FY27 margin rose further, to 14.5%; PAT was 2,393, up 113.7% YoY on revenue growth of 10.1%. No reversal is visible yet.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management said 15-20% growth can be sustained irrespective of gold rate.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: H1 FY27 revenue was up 19.1%, but Q2 FY27 grew only 10.1% YoY (20,614 vs 18,725) and fell from 21,356 in Q1, even with Damas in the current period and not the base.

bull.point: Revenue growth beat what the earlier calls promised
bull.evidence: FY26 revenue 87,584, up 44.9% on FY25's 60,456. 9M FY26 growth (+33.2%) beat H1 (+26.8%), as promised.
bull.source: reported numbers; Q2 FY26 call p10

bull.evidence: TTM PAT 7,033 vs FY26 PAT 5,073. Q2 FY27 PAT 2,393 vs 1,120 a year earlier (+113.7%), on EBITDA margin of 14.5%.
Operating cash flow was 5,590 in FY26, against -541 in FY25. Borrowings fell to 27,638 in FY27 from 30,621 in FY26.

bear.point: Recent margins include one-off gains that management expects to reverse
bear.evidence: Management said Q1 FY27 customs-duty and MTM gains will reverse over 2-3 quarters. Normalised jewellery margin was 10.9%, against a reported consolidated EBITDA margin of 13.5% (14.5% in Q2).

bear.point: Growth is slowing, and the target language has softened
bear.evidence: Q2 FY27 revenue grew 10.1% YoY with Damas included, so organic growth was likely lower. Guidance moved from '15-20% CAGR' (Q4 FY26) to 'double-digit' (Q1 FY27).
bear.source: reported numbers; Q4 FY26 call p11; Q1 FY27 call p10

bear.point: Working capital and debt have grown, and margins swing widely
bear.evidence: Inventory days went from 176 (FY24) to 222 (FY26), and the cash conversion cycle reached 211 days. Borrowings rose from 15,528 (FY24) to 30,621 (FY26). Q4 FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 7.2%.

call.credential: Manager, Tanishq Strategy & Planning at Titan Company, 2013–2020
call.knows: how leadership thinks about the business and its options
